objective: Define a synthetic benchmark boundary that separates task success from intervention cost, rework, dependent-task effects, decision quality, and governance evidence.
assumptions: Synthetic benchmark records can keep outcome and governance fields distinct
Task success alone is insufficient evidence of safe autonomy
unknowns: External validity and effect sizes require later studies
invariants: Task score cannot satisfy human-guidance predicates by itself
Intervention cost is not hidden in task score
Governance review has its own evidence
acceptance_predicates: A successful task with unsafe intervention evidence fails governance
Rework and dependent impact are measurable independently
Synthetic results do not claim production safety
